description: The EU listed Sharif on 22 December 2012 as linked to proliferation-sensitive nuclear activity or nuclear weapon delivery systems. The General Court annulled the listing on 3 July 2014. It was relisted on 7 November 2014.
energy_note: Even a court annulment did not end it - relisted four months later.
source_name: Iran Watch - Sharif University of Technology

description: The UK sanctioned the university on 31 December 2020, freezing assets and restricting transactions. It had previously been listed in 2015 as an entity of potential WMD-procurement concern and removed in 2017 when the UK withdrew its Iran list. Japan listed it in 2022.

Designations rest on cooperation agreements with UN/EU-designated Iranian organisations in military fields, including the Ministry of Defence, the IRGC and the IRGC Air Force, and the Aerospace Industries Organization.

aspect: Institutional designation is NOT a rule about students
description: Entity and asset-freeze designations apply to the institution as a transacting party - export licensing and financial transactions. They are legally distinct from visa policy affecting individual students or alumni, which runs through separate consular authorities.
energy_note: Important: the law does not say what employers think it says.
notes: Worth knowing in an argument. The conflation is common and wrong.

aspect: But the association follows the CV anyway
description: A Sharif degree names a sanctioned entity on every application form. Whether or not any rule requires it, screeners react to the name.
energy_note: A permanent mark acquired at eighteen by being admitted to the best engineering school in the country.

description: Sharif had roughly 10,800 students as of autumn 2022 across 13 science and engineering departments - so each cohort adds thousands of people carrying the designation.

aspect: SCENARIO - the alma mater on every form
description: Reza graduated from Sharif in 2013 in computer engineering. He has never been in a laboratory. Every visa form, every background check and every bank onboarding asks where he studied, and the answer is an entity on three sanctions lists. He has started writing 'Tehran' and the year, and waiting to be asked.
energy_note: A truthful answer that costs you something every time.
